summary: Serves /graph/ by inlining site-astro/src/graph-page.html (a complete standalone document with its own head, CSS and canvas script) via a ?raw import into a bare <Fragment set:html>. It exists as a ROUTE rather than as public/graph/index.html because `astro dev` serves public/ by exact path with no directory-index fallback: the file answered /graph/index.html and 404'd on /graph/, the URL the nav links to, while production resolved it fine — a dev-only break invisible in CI. Being a route also puts /graph/ in the sitemap. It strips the generated file's leading doctype because Astro emits its own ahead of the template.
